decisions.reason: [F4] restates an R-module cross-product supplier as an integral-chain assertion and step 1.1 invokes it for arbitrary R-cycles. This is not licensed by the cited dependencies: for R=F_2 the degree-two cellular boundary of RP^2 is zero, whereas it is multiplication by 2 integrally, so H_2(RP^2;F_2)=F_2 has no integral-cycle lift since H_2(RP^2;Z)=0. Replaced the false integral carrier with C_{m+n}(X times Y;R) and distinguished cycles z,w from their classes. [F3] now explicitly extends the integral shuffle, boundary and naturality identities by scalars; no lifting of R-cycles is used.

reviews.reason: Reviewed the assigned statement, all six facts, three proof steps, owning contract and home-page interface. The R-linear shuffle S maps z tensor w to an R-cycle; TS-1=dK+Kd makes JTS(z tensor w)=J(z tensor w), since Jd=0. Its bidegree support gives the matched-degree product and zero otherwise at the same total degree. The AW front/back formula gives JA, and A-T=dH+Hd gives JA-JT=delta(JH), proving the external-cup convention without Kunneth bijectivity or AC. Scalar extension of the integral chain maps and homotopies needs no flatness assumption, and integral input cycles extend into R before evaluation. Degree zero, empty factors and the zero ring are covered. This is a local repair review, not independent review of my repair.
